q-vs-k-line.alt: A number line for Q starting at Q = 0 (no products) on the left and increasing to the right. K is marked in the middle. To the left of K, Q is less than K and an arrow points right toward K: the net reaction goes forward, products form and Q rises. To the right of K, Q is greater than K and an arrow points left toward K: the net reaction goes in reverse, reactants form and Q falls. At K, Q equals K and there is no net change.
